proposal.observation: detected_lines.png: the outlier binary map is very sparse; joint traces appear only as faint dotted rows at y~1470 and y~1640, and oblique Hough segments (red/green) are recovered almost exclusively over the right seven rings (x > ~850 px). Rings 1-3 on the left yield essentially no oblique lines, so their prompt centres are propagated rather than detected (initial_prompt_points.png shows 10 'propagated' points, none 'detected'). The 10 magenta vertical lines match expected_rings=10 and ring_count_error=0, so the vertical band is healthy. depth_map_viridis.png shows NaN voids concentrated in the top ~15% band, the mid horizontal joint row, and the bottom ~10%, consistent with depth_nan_ratio=0.142 (moderate). segmentation_results.png shows a coherent 10-ring instance map and a K/B/A band layout, consistent with sam_fill_rate=0.698. The weakest incumbent measurement is correspondence_f1@15=0.287 (chamfer_sym_px=80), i.e. predicted block boundaries are offset from image edges.
proposal.rule: d6 (m_joint_contrast low in the outlier map) together with d7 (m_line_yield low; oblique lines missing on the left rings so centres are propagated instead of detected). Remediation r_relax_hough: lower the oblique HoughLinesP threshold and raise maxLineGap; additionally lower the binarisation threshold so the faint dotted joint traces survive s4_2 binarise-and-dilate. Preconditions: f_depth_holes is moderate (nan ratio 0.14, not a large void inside the joint rows), and f_joint_oversmoothed cannot be addressed here because depth_threshold_low/high are outside the bounded parameter set, so the in-bounds stage-4 relaxation is the admissible action. Vertical threshold is left untouched because ring count is already correct.
proposal.failure_mode: stage_4_detection.f_missing_lines (upstream suspect stage_3_upsample.f_joint_oversmoothed), propagating to stage_5_segmentation.f_crop_offset and hence low boundary correspondence.
proposal.rationale: All three worked examples changed every stage jointly and every one lowered the proxy (0.624 -> 0.480/0.209/0.509), with sam_fill_rate collapsing each time; this argues against broad overlays from a 'refine'-band incumbent. The incumbent already has ring_count_error=0 and acceptable fill/NaN, so the targeted lever is correspondence_f1@15, whose evidence in the images is missing oblique joint lines on the left rings. A detecting-only overlay that lowers binary_threshold toward the low end of its bound, lowers hough_threshold_oblique and raises maxLineGap_oblique should raise oblique line yield so more rings get detected rather than propagated K-joint loci, tightening prompt-centre placement and the SAM crop/template alignment without touching the unfolding (stage-1 is only marginally unlocked, residual 10.2 vs 10.0 gate, and all example overlays that changed unfolding degraded), denoising, or SAM geometry. Values stay strictly inside configs/bounds/continuous.json. This is a joint stage-4 change; no per-parameter causal attribution is claimed.
